paragraphs.text: The Langmuir model was fitted to the adsorption of caffeine on coffee biochar at pH 6 and 22 C.
The maximum adsorption capacity was 88 mg/g in this demo dataset.
A Langmuir model was compared with a Freundlich model for caffeine uptake on rice-husk biochar at pH 4.
The maximum adsorption capacity was 132 mg/g for the rice-husk biochar.
